title: RBI Eases Acquisition Financing Norms for Banks
summary: RBI raises bank exposure cap for acquisition financing from 10% to 20% of capital and allows financing for unlisted acquisitions.

blocks.content: RBI relaxed acquisition financing rules, raising the bank exposure ceiling from **10% to 20% of capital** and extending eligibility to unlisted companies (net worth ≥₹500 Cr).

items: **Financing Share**: Raised from 70% to 75% of acquisition value (debt-to-equity capped at 3:1).
**Lending Against Shares**: Ceiling raised from ₹20 lakh to ₹1 crore.
